column1: # Provisional game profile of Farming Simulator: Nintendo Switch Edition (Switch, base game v0 + update v65536), GIANTS Engine 7.0.0, SDK 1.6.0, NVN. Written from a survey of the
# game files with dm/games/profile_guess.py; the game has not been booted with it. Every key marked "guess" follows a rule or a sibling profile and is not measured. README.md beside this file.
# The shader split reads no shader of this game yet (they are in shared/shader_switch.sharc, a format it does not know): the pack's shader library is empty. See README.md
# guess: a 3D game driven with both sticks and the D-pad; nothing in the files decides it
# The display version was not read (the import keeps no control data)
# guess (profile_guess.py's rule: every module main imports from): load order as on Horizon, main, subsdk0, subsdk1, subsdk2, sdk. On SDK 1.6.0 the SDK is in four modules: subsdk0 holds
# nn::swkbd (main takes 6 functions), subsdk1 is NintendoSDK_NVN (nvnBootstrapLoader, nv::InitializeGraphics, nv::SetGraphicsAllocator), subsdk2 holds nn::sf and nn::vi (6 functions).
# No other profile loads an NVN module of its own: whether the host's NVN and nn::vi answer before these modules' was not checked
# the file types that are big or already compressed (profile_guess.py's rule)
# guess (profile_guess.py's rule, not measured): the NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0), so there is no virtual address memory, and main imports nn::os::SetMemoryHeapSize:
# the 4 GB layout of such games (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region), with the hardware pool
# no mem_used: the modules are 12 MB before the rewrite, under the default 64 MB of used memory
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py finds no shader: see README.md) ----
